headline: Sensex and Nifty extend weekly gains on FII inflows, while inflation and oil prices remain key focus areas.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) have driven gains with consistent buying activity.
WPI inflation concerns continue to weigh on broader market sentiment.
Lower crude oil prices provided early support to equities.
A retreat in AI stocks globally has fueled a rotation trade back into Indian equities.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty posted gains for the third consecutive week.
PSU bank stocks surged 7.5% while smallcaps jumped 3.6% during recent trading.
Markets experienced volatility with Sensex dropping 289 points in a session due to inflation worries.
Upcoming market direction is expected to be guided by WPI inflation data, oil prices, and FII flows.
summary: Indian stock markets extended weekly gains for the third straight week, supported by foreign fund inflows and strong rallies in PSU banks and smallcaps. However, inflation concerns and shifting global cues caused intermittent pullbacks. Market participants are closely watching upcoming WPI inflation data, crude oil movements, and FII trading activity for direction.
